# Sirin

> AI-driven browser test daemon — local-only MCP server exposing exactly 190 tools for browser automation, E2E tests, knowledge-base search, physical-device validation, and multi-agent squad orchestration.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention so AI clients
can discover the API surface in one fetch.  Humans should open `/ui/` instead.

## Connect

- **MCP HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0)**: `http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp`
- **Dashboard**: `http://127.0.0.1:7700/ui/`
- **Welcome / landing**: `http://127.0.0.1:7700/welcome`
- **Help (HTML)**: `http://127.0.0.1:7700/help`
- **Snapshot**: `http://127.0.0.1:7700/api/snapshot`
- **WebSocket (live updates)**: `ws://127.0.0.1:7700/ws`

The fastest way to learn what's available is to call the `help` MCP tool:

```sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"help"},"id":1}'
```

It returns a structured JSON envelope with: connection-config snippets for
Claude Desktop / Cline / Cursor, top-level tool categories, caveats, and a
3-step quickstart curl example.

## Quick start (3 steps)

```sh
# 1. List all 190 tools
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/list","id":1}'

# 2. Run an E2E test (returns run_id immediately)
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"run_test_async","arguments":{"test_id":"agora_admin_status_chip"}},"id":1}'

# 3. Poll for result (replace RUN_ID)
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_test_result","arguments":{"run_id":"RUN_ID"}},"id":1}'
```

## Tool categories

- **browser_automation** — `browser_exec` (45+ CDP actions: navigate / click / type / screenshot / scroll / shadow_dump / vision)
- **e2e_tests** — `run_test_async`, `run_test_batch`, `run_regression_suite`, `get_test_result`
- **coverage** — `test_coverage`, `script_health`
- **knowledge_base** — `kb_search`, `kbWrite`, `kb_stats`
- **multi_agent_squad** — `agent_assign_task`, `agent_queue_status`, `cleanup_stale_worktrees`
- **handoff** — `create_handoff`, `get_latest_handoff`
- **live_observation** — `live_trace`, `queue_status`, `tail_app_log`
- **memory** — `memory_search`, `record_memory`

Full list: [`tools/list`](http://127.0.0.1:7700/mcp) MCP method.

## Caveats

- **Concurrency = 1** — `TEST_RUN_LOCK` serialises runs. Check `queue_status` for ETA.
- **Idle close** — Chrome auto-closes after 60 s of no active tests (`SIRIN_BROWSER_IDLE_CLOSE_SECS`).
- **No auth** — Bind is `127.0.0.1` only. For remote use, add a reverse proxy with auth.
- **Replay first** — Tests with saved scripts run in ~10 s at $0 cost. LLM ReAct fallback is 30-300 s.
